syntheticInputs.codeShape: Three distinct valid 43-character strings made only from repeated a, b and c, in that order; no real capability.
syntheticInputs.response: One deferred HTTP 200 text response, released after the second submission and before the third.
syntheticInputs.clock: Fixed performance.now() value of zero; refresh timers are inert.

limitations: Actual receipt client evaluated in a Node VM with a minimal synthetic DOM.
Deferred transport is injected; no browser, handler, network, database, credentials or provider is used.
The stale response is discarded before DOM parsing; receipt rendering and integrity checks are outside this witness.
This is a before-change defect witness, not a passing acceptance test for repaired behavior.
